description: Generic Nintendo DS game profile. SNES-shaped diamond (A east, B south, Y west, X north) plus L/R shoulders. Nintendo Western convention: A is confirm. The stylus / touch screen is not represented in v1 (pointer wire kind not yet wired through the BridgedAdapter).

confirm.hint: Press A. Advance dialog, confirm menu choice, primary action.

cancel.hint: Press B. Cancel menu, run, secondary action.

special.hint: Press Y. Game-specific: secondary action, sub-attack, sprint.

use_item.hint: Press X. Game-specific: tertiary action, inventory hotkey.

menu.hint: Press Start. Open the pause menu, start the game from the title screen.

back.hint: Press Select. Game-specific: secondary menu, character / mode swap.

nav_up.hint: Walk / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: Stylus support is the major omission of v1. Many NDS titles are stylus-driven (Brain Age, Hotel Dusk, Trauma Center); for those the agent runs vision-only with button-only inputs. Adding stylus requires a pointer wire kind through the BridgedAdapter — separate scope from this profile.
